verdict.rationale: name.com documents a dedicated Check Availability endpoint (up to 50 domains, discovery pricing) under the Core API, secured via documented Basic Auth, with official SDKs (TS/Go/PHP), a sandbox testing environment for automated integration tests, and even an official MCP server so agents can call these operations. Missing for 10: explicit documented rate-limit numbers/policy for the API and independent/hands-on confirmation of the check-availability endpoint's real-world behavior.
